name: gog-enhancer-tests
description: Test harness for the GOG Enhancer extension. The extension itself ships as plain vanilla JS — this package.json exists only so contributors can run vitest against the pure utility modules.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.pages-popup.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.pages-onboarding.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.pages-options.json
scripts.lint:firefox: node scripts/build-firefox.mjs --no-zip && npx --yes web-ext@latest lint -s dist/firefox
